title: Fix PDF export to generate actual PDF files using jsPDF

requirements.text: Rewrite frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts to use jsPDF correctly: import jsPDF from 'jspdf' and import 'jspdf-autotable', create a new jsPDF instance, add a title using doc.text(), add the pioneers table using doc.autoTable() with columns for Name, Service Year, Total Hours, Average Hours, and Status, and save the file using doc.save('pioneers-report.pdf'). Remove all HTML generation and blob/anchor download logic.

quotes: The current implementation is saving as .html files instead of .pdf files.
Import jsPDF properly at the top of the file
Add content to the PDF using doc.text() and doc.autoTable() methods
Save using doc.save('filename.pdf') NOT with .html extension

acceptanceCriteria: pioneersPdfExport.ts imports jsPDF from 'jspdf' and imports 'jspdf-autotable'
A new jsPDF instance is created with `new jsPDF()`
A title is added to the PDF using doc.text()
Pioneer data is added as a table using doc.autoTable() with the correct column headers
The file is saved via doc.save('pioneers-report.pdf')
No HTML string generation or blob-based download logic remains in the file
Clicking the Export to PDF button on the Pioneers page downloads an actual .pdf file that opens in a PDF viewer
